text:
sam: Hey folks — opened PR #4821 to update embeddings section in the model catalog with throughput guidance and an SDK example. Quick ask: can someone sanity-check the tokens/sec numbers and the streaming example? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 :white_check_mark:

rachel: taking a look now. can you paste the exact command you used for the bench? was it the new bench harness?

sam: yep used /tools/bench/embeds_runner --model orion-embedding-1 --batch 32 --seq 512 --device a100. output: 12.6k tokens/sec for fp16, 7.8k for int8. i'll paste raw output:
```
Batch 32 seq 512 model orion-embedding-1 device a100 fp16 throughput 12600 tokens/sec
Batch 32 seq 512 model orion-embedding-1 device a100 int8 throughput 7800 tokens/sec
```

ben: numbers look plausible. add a note about payload size effect — small docs <128 tokens will saturate differently. also mention that int8 uses per-layer calibration (see quant-profiles doc).

elaine: CI failing on the doc build (link-check). broken link to internal bench dashboard in the PR: https://redwood-internal/bench/embeds-2026 -> 404. remove or replace with public permalinks.

sam: good catch. i'll swap link to the public perf dashboard: https://perf.redwood.ai/embeddings/2026-summary and push fix.

rachel: for the SDK snippet please prefer the new python client snippet pattern, e.g.
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.embeddings.create(model='orion-embedding-1', input=['short doc','long doc...'], batch_size=32)
print(resp[0].vector[:8])
```
we should include arg for device_hint and mention batching.

ben: also add a short note on limits: max_tokens_per_request 1024 for that model, and recommended batch <=64 to hit 200ms tail p50.

sam: assigning myself to update PR with link fix and bench outputs. @rachel can you drop the python snippet into the examples section? @ben can you add the note about limits/latency? @elaine can you re-run link-check after i push?

rachel: on it, will open a follow-up commit.

elaine: will re-run once pushed. FYI doc build flake often due to mkdocs cache — clear cache if it persists.

docs-bot: PR #4821 status: tests failed (link-check). Reviewer requested: rachel, ben.

sam: pushed fixes -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821/files

rachel: LGTM on snippet, added minor wording. left one inline comment about "tokens/sec" wording (suggest "tokens/s").

ben: resolved my comments, added limit table row.

elaine: link-check passed on re-run. merging when 2 approvals.

sam: thanks all :tada:
